segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin, including one specifically targeting an oily T-zone, report it regulates oil and reduces congestion in oily areas without drying out the rest of the face.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, chronically dry, or flaky skin report the essence is a key step for retaining moisture, describing dry patches becoming visibly softer and less flaky with regular use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including a reactive T-zone, report the essence calmed redness and irritability in the T-zone without disrupting the rest of the face.
segments.sensitive: This is where the product is most consistently praised: reviewers with sensitive, reactive, rosacea-prone or severely sensitive skin report it calms redness and irritation, with no reports of triggering breakouts or stinging.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as average reports the essence calmed the flakiness and redness she gets from retinol, though she found similar results from cica or centella products.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 60s with mature skin report the essence is calming and hydrating without looking shiny, with one noting improved skin tone and plumpness over her whole body.

concerns.dehydration: This is the dominant reported benefit: reviewers across ages and skin types, including chronically dry skin, describe fast-absorbing, lasting hydration without heaviness or pilling under other products.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers, including some with rosacea or reactive skin, report the essence visibly calms redness with consistent use; no reviewer in this set reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the essence with helping heal her compromised skin barrier alongside calming redness on her combination/oily skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report fewer breakouts and calmer skin over time, with one crediting it for both active acne and acne scarring; no reviewer reports it causing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers report the essence helps regulate excess oil and reduce congestion in oily areas like the T-zone, without over-drying the rest of the face.

extraits.titre: Mugwort essence, light brown liquid with herbal sent.Mugwort essence, light brown liquid with herbal sent.
extraits.texte: This toner came in a tall, plastic bottle and it is easy to use. I usually apply it on a cotton round and than wipe my face. Watery texture absorbs quickly into the skin, but it is a little bit sticky. I am using it at the evening, but it is also suitable for the morning routines. The ad description said "Crafted with a single plant-based ingredient", but there are a lot of other ingredients in the ingredients list. So, maybe some older formula had a less ingredients, but this one have much more. Water, Artemisia Princeps Extract, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ethyl hexylglycerin, Propanediol, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate. It is slightly sticky when apply, but it quickly absorbs. The benefits of mugwort extract are expected to have hydrating and calming effect. The color is light brown and the scent is herbal and light. I do not notice any special benefits after applying, but don't have any irritation either.

I've probably been through at least 10 bottles of the I'm From Mugwort Essence at this point. Out of all the skincare products, this is the one product I will always recommend to everyone around me. It's incredibly calming and soothing, and it's great for all skin types. Ever since I started using it, my skin has become noticeably less red, and I rarely ever break out anymore. I use it every morning and night after toner, and my skin drinks it up. Mugwort is also known for it's healing properties, so this is great for anyone with acne or acne scarring. This is truly a product that does it all; if you're someone who struggles with dryness, oil, acne, and/or sensitive skin, this is a must-have for you. I have severely sensitive skin, and this is one of the only products that have been able to get rid of my redness and calm it down. I cannot recommend this enough!!!
This is my second bottle of this essence. It's soothing and hydrating on my combo/oily skin and doesn't cause any breakouts. It helps calm any redness and helped to heal my skin barrier.

extraits.titre: A Fantastic Addition To My Skin Care Routine!  A Must Have For Mature Dry Sensitive Skin!A Fantastic Addition To My Skin
extraits.texte: The I'm From Mugwort line is one of the best skin care lines I have ever used. My skin loves the mugwort products. I have mature (age 60) dry sensitive skin. I have been using a toner on my face, neck, and upper chest area daily, and wanted to try an essence product to rotate in with my toner. This Mugwort Essence is beyond fantastic for my skin over my entire body, including my scalp! - Application: I empty a small amount in the palm of my hand, then pat it on my face, neck, upper chest, and anywhere else on my body where my skin needs some TLC. It absorbs into your skin rapidly. Don't squeeze the bottle, as the product is very liquidy. I just shake the bottle a bit and the product comes out. - This essence can be used as a replacement for your toner, or layered along with your toner. - I have been amazed at how beneficial this essence has been for my scalp and hair care. My scalp is much less dry and irritate since I began using this essence on my scalp and very short pixie style hair. - This essence has a warming effect on my skin as my circulation improves. My skin has more color, and is soft and more plump. - This essence is a bit more expensive than some other skin care products, but in my opinion the fantastic results I experience make this product a terrific value. I highly recommend this Mugwort Essence product.

​I have integrated this mugwort essence into my daily routine for quite some time, and it has become an essential solution for my chronic dry skin. Its greatest strength is how effectively it helps my skin retain moisture post-cleansing, acting as the perfect preparatory layer. ​The formula is incredibly lightweight and soothing on the skin. Because you only need a small amount to see results, a single bottle lasts for months, making it an excellent value. It layers seamlessly with the rest of my skincare products without any pilling or heaviness. If you are looking for a gentle, effective essence that preps the skin and enhances hydration, this is a fantastic choice.

My wife has added these two products from "I'm From" to her skin care regiment and is loving them.. This one helps with oily skin so well.. To the point she is making me start using it now. Highly recommend this product for oily skin!
